turn_of_month.name: Turn of the Month
turn_of_month.description: Buy last 4 days of month, sell first 3 of new month. Captures month-end SIP/MF flows.

holiday_effect.name: Holiday Effect
holiday_effect.description: Buy 2 days before NSE holidays, sell 1 day after. Pre-holiday optimism drift.

days_down_overnight.name: Days Down Overnight
days_down_overnight.description: Buy after 3+ consecutive down closes, sell next open. Mean-reversion.

all_time_high.name: All-Time High Breakout
all_time_high.description: Buy new 252-day highs, sell on 10% drawdown. Trend-following.

dual_momentum.name: Dual Momentum
dual_momentum.description: Buy if up over 12mo AND beating NIFTY. Trend + relative strength.

bollinger_squeeze.name: Bollinger Squeeze
bollinger_squeeze.description: Buy when BB width hits 6-mo low then price breaks above upper band. Volatility expansion.

rsi_2.name: RSI(2) Connors
rsi_2.description: Buy RSI(2)<10, sell RSI(2)>70. Larry Connors' ultra-short mean reversion.

golden_cross.name: Golden/Death Cross
golden_cross.description: Buy when 50-SMA crosses above 200-SMA. Classic long-term trend-following.

mean_reversion_z.name: Mean Reversion Z-Score
mean_reversion_z.description: Buy at -2 std dev, sell at +2 std dev from 20-SMA. Classical mean reversion.

new_52w_high.name: 52-Week New High
new_52w_high.description: Buy within 2% of 52-week high, sell on 15% drawdown. Momentum persistence.

volume_breakout.name: Volume Breakout
volume_breakout.description: Buy on 2x volume + new 20-day high. Sell on 1.5x volume breakdown.

vwap_reclaim.name: VWAP/20-SMA Reclaim
vwap_reclaim.description: Buy when close reclaims 20-SMA from below with above-avg volume.

three_bar_reversal.name: 3-Bar Reversal
three_bar_reversal.description: Buy after 3 down days followed by 3 up days. Classic price action.

macd_divergence.name: MACD Histogram Divergence
macd_divergence.description: Buy on bullish divergence (price lower low, MACD higher low). Reversal signal.

atr_breakout.name: ATR Breakout
atr_breakout.description: Buy on 1.5x ATR range day closing in upper half. Volatility expansion.

weekend_effect.name: Weekend Effect
weekend_effect.description: Buy Friday close, sell Monday open. Captures weekend risk premium.
